paper.title_en: Bondi-Sachs formalism on past light cones and an analogue of the integral mass formula
paper.abstract_en: Following a proposal that the thermodynamic aspects of general relativity can be found in the evolution of the past light cones of arbitrary worldlines, we generalize the Bondi-Sachs formalism to these surfaces. The observer may accelerate and rotate their tetrad, the spacetime may contain matter and a cosmological constant, and no symmetry is assumed. We impose regularity conditions at the vertex of each light cone and along the polar axis, including a general axial condition that allows for shear. Given a suitable prescription for the stresses of matter, the Einstein field equations can then be integrated hierarchically from data on a single light cone, and the regularity at the vertex fixes all constants of integration. The solution reveals a universal property: to first order in the observer's proper time, the evolution of the metric and of the four-momentum crossing the light cones is independent of the specific behavior of matter. As an application, we derive, for an observer immersed in matter, an analogue of the integral mass formula of black hole mechanics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将Bondi-Sachs形式推广到任意世界线的过去光锥，涵盖加速与转动参考系、含物质与宇宙常数的时空且不假设对称性，并给出正则性条件与逐级积分方案，进而导出黑洞力学积分质量公式的类比。理论深度与新意较高，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞热力学交叉方向，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 过去光锥上的Bondi-Sachs形式及积分质量公式的类比
decision.abstract_zh: 遵循一个主张，即广义相对论的热力学方面可以在任意世界线的过去光锥演化中找到，我们将Bondi-Sachs形式推广到这些曲面。观测者可以加速并转动其四元标架，时空可以包含物质和宇宙学常数，且不假设任何对称性。我们在每个光锥的顶点处以及沿极轴施加正则性条件，其中包括一个允许剪切的通用轴向条件。在给定物质应力的适当规定后，爱因斯坦场方程便可从单个光锥上的数据逐级积分，而顶点处的正则性确定了所有积分常数。该解揭示了一个普适性质：在观测者固有时的一阶近似下，度规以及穿过光锥的四维动量的演化与物质的具体行为无关。作为应用，我们针对浸没于物质中的观测者，导出了黑洞力学积分质量公式的一个类比。
